scenario: [LGRA.5.8.6]: a value a rule makes, at the string-bytes limit, is written. The rule caches a `String` slot holding 16,384 ASCII `a`s (the harness's `$repeat` form); `cache` wraps the value as a `Json` string ([IDSP.7]), one node of exactly 16,384 string bytes, within every limit, so the write happens and the stream carries `action_cache_set`. Paired with LGRA.5.8.6_rule_cache_string_over_limit_raises and _writes_nothing, one byte longer. PATH PINNED: on libds, `adapter_ds_json_value` renders the value and `adapter_ds_cache_set` re-parses that text against the tree limits (`ds_json_parse_limited`, text limit off); on the Mercury runtime, `ds.exec.cache_set_verb` through `json_over_limit`.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    k: Int key
    s: String mutable

rule r:
    T t
->
    cache key: "k" value: t.s
